name: Argo Analytics for a zone at different PoPs
description: Argo Analytics for a zone at different PoPs Retrieves Argo Smart Routing analytics broken down by geographic points of presence (PoPs). GET /client/v4/zones/{zone_id}/analytics/latency/colos
context:

context:
